recipes.procedure: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface.
Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large salad bowl.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until golden. Add chopped vegetable.
In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. In another bowl, and melted butter.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add chopped tomatoes.
Marinate chicken strips with lime juice, chili powder, cumin, garlic, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Grease ramekins with butter and dust with cocoa powder.
